Xã Thăng An nằm ở vùng ven biển phía Nam: Thang An Commune is in the city's southern coastal area, along the Truong Giang River (the Thang Binh area of former Quang Nam before the merger). Under the Da Nang General Master Plan to 2050, Thang An is one of 7 new urban areas expected to form, along with Duy Nghia, Thang Dien, Thang Truong, Tay Ho, Vu Gia and Hoang Sa. The area still has a large land bank and is close to the coastal axis and the South Hoi An resorts – conditions suited to a large-scale entertainment complex that would be hard to fit in inner Da Nang.
